name: Midcoast Internet
summary: Port Macquarie / Mid North Coast NSW dialup ISP (midcoast.com.au, site live by Nov 1995); Defunct. NOTE: distinct from MediaCraft Interactive (mci.com.au). Research suggests it later merged into Central Connect's 'Coull Network' (Dec 2022).
